name: Control Theory
description: Feedback, stability, and the dynamics of systems that regulate themselves.

name: Electromagnetism
description: Electric and magnetic fields and their interplay: forces on charges, circuits, and electromagnetic phenomena.

name: Fluid Mechanics
description: The behavior of fluids: pressure, viscosity, and flow at rest and in motion.

name: Gravitation
description: Newtonian gravity, orbital motion, and the dynamics of bodies moving under universal attraction.

name: Mechanics
description: The motion of objects and the forces, energy, and momentum that govern it, from point masses on tracks to rigid-body rotation.

name: Optics
description: The behavior of light: reflection, refraction, imaging, and how optical systems and cameras form images.
